The actions PNG was then opened by itself. It visibly contains the complete dialog, all 64 equipment-name characters, both zero-credit terms, the XP quote and both action buttons. No missing dialog is present in the original image.

The original initial and after-scroll DOM probes agree: dialog x=456.796875, y=51.734375, width=452.40625, height=664.53125. Both button-center native hit tests succeeded, with no overlapping action rectangles.

scrollHeight and clientHeight were both 663; initial and after-scroll scrollTop were both 0. This legal long-name fixture fit without actual scrolling, so scrollIntoViewIfNeeded did not need to move the dialog. The run does not establish an actual scroll-distance test for this fixture.
Native cancel retained every exact storage byte. Reopening and native double-click confirmation committed one exact engine-predicted transaction, removed only the reserved item and survived reload.
The preserved automated report is 1 scenario / 57 assertions / 0 console or page errors, with stable runtime hashes. The corrected reading adds neither a new defect nor extra functional coverage.

cause.statement: The source PNGs do not reproduce the initially reported omission. This was a false alarm in visual tool display or interpretation; the evidence does not establish which presentation or reading step produced it. No game rendering or screenshot compositor defect is supported.
